listing.name: WipEout / Alexbeav PSXRecomp
listing.summary: PlayStation port prepared with your own matching disc and any required BIOS. Complete setup with the project’s launcher; you manage this copy, its updates and your saved data.

steps.title: Download the upstream setup package
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official setup ZIP for your system into a separate writable folder you control. Its launcher builds the game using your own matching disc. On Linux, follow that version’s prerequisites, including CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and a C/C++ compiler where required; bundled Windows tools do not supply Linux tools. Downloading and extracting do not start setup or the game. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay for this package.

steps.title: Supply the matching original files
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream guide for the version you downloaded. Use your own original in its supported image representation, keeping a CUE and every referenced track together when required, and supply your own BIOS whenever that guide requires it. Preserve the exact edition, disc layout and BIOS requirements in that guide; an included setup BIOS does not establish game compatibility.

steps.title: Finish upstream setup, then add the player
steps.instruction: Open the project’s launcher to build the game from your own files. Follow the instructions for that version and keep the completed game with its required runtime and compiler files. In Portcove, select the completed game executable or supported launcher and its working folder. If setup created the game elsewhere, select that location. Save the launch details, then choose Play when you are ready. You manage updates, original files, saves and settings; Portcove does not back up these external files. Keep a working copy and its data before changing versions.
